name: The Honking Deep (eldritch goose boss)
scale_note: Boss scale against the 1.80 m reference human: 5.1 m to the tips of the main head's quill crest (crown of the head about 4.95 m), 8.5 m across from finger-claw to finger-claw. Faces -Y, +Z up, origin on the ground between the feet. All design numbers below are metres in that frame.
budget_note: Hero asset: about 30x the scythe prop's budget. Every tooth, rib and feather is real geometry, not a texture.

build: Body: lofted ellipse rings, about 3.7 m long, 1.88 m wide, lowest point 1.06 m; soot-brown back, ashen bars on the flanks, grimy breast (straight seam at y = -0.42 m) with dried blood run down from the maw, dirty-bone belly and undertail; five bare ribs break through each flank.

Necks: one main S-neck from the breast to 4.7 m, radius 0.36 m tapering to 0.165 m; two side necks out to +/-1.36 m, radius 0.26 to 0.13 m. All black, a ridge of 13 bone spines down the back of the main neck.

Heads: goose heads with the white chinstrap, one small sunken dark eye a side, beaks gaping (42 deg main, 58 deg side) with rows of teeth on both mandibles and a spiked tongue. Side heads at 0.74 scale.
Breast maw: a vertical mouth 0.34 m wide x 0.84 m tall on the breast, raw lips, 22 teeth around the rim, dark throat.

Wings: raised and spread, 8.5 m across including the bare finger bones, arm 0.17 m to 0.04 m thick; 10 badly ragged primaries 1.45 to 1.05 m, 12 secondaries, 5 tertials, two covert rows; two finger bones 1.25 m long with claws break out past the primaries.
Legs: black, hip 1.55 m to ankle; three webbed toes 0.48 m long spread 32 deg, bone claws, a small back toe.
Tail: nine ragged black feathers 0.9 m long in a cupped fan over 80 deg, outer feathers banked and drooping so the fan reads from the side.
Spines: a bone ridge along the back and down the main neck; a crest of quills behind each head.
style: Bloodborne-leaning gothic beast horror: soot, ash, grimy bone and dried blood; starved and ragged rather than many-eyed. No emissive materials.
